reasons: The cited Section 4.4 is the audit right binding our party (Corio, the licensee) and satisfies the playbook's material terms: frequency capped at once each calendar year, inspection limited to books and records (no access to Customer systems or premises), performed by an independent CPA reasonably acceptable to us, at reasonable times, with Commerce One bearing all costs unless an underpayment exceeding 5% is found — at or above the preferred position.

Correctly classified as compliant rather than a deviation; the only shortfalls ("reasonable notice" instead of a fixed 30/15-day period, and auditor confidentiality handled via the general confidentiality section/NDA rather than expressly in the clause) are minor sub-elements properly noted in the rationale rather than redlined.

No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original and the deterministic check on audit frequency passes.

Rationale is accurate to the quoted text (two-way true-up, 5% threshold, off-site records review) and no other audit/inspection right against us is implicated, so there is no double-flagging or missed walk-away trigger.
